PURITY PATROL OBERFAHN
CR 12

XP 19,200
Auttaine fighter 7/inquisitor 6
LN Medium humanoid (half-construct, human)
Init +6; Senses Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 11, flat-footed 16 (+6 armor, +1 Dex)
hp 101 (13 HD; 6d8+7d10+32)
Fort +14, Ref +5, Will +10 (+2 vs. fear); +2 bonus vs. disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue.
Resist construct resistances

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk bastard sword +14/+9/+4 (1d10+5/17–20)
Ranged mwk pepperbox rifle +9/+4/–1 (1d10+2/x4)
Special Attacks bane (6 rounds/day), judgment 2/day, weapon training (heavy blades +1)
Domain Spell-Like Abilities (CL 6th; concentration +7)

4/day—touch of law

Inquisitor Spell-Like Abilities (CL 6th; concentration +7)

At will—detect alignment, discern lies (6 rounds/day)

Inquisitor Spells Known (CL 6th; concentration +7)

2nd (3/day)—bloodhound, confess (DC 13), inflict pain (DC 13), mindshock
1st (5/day)—cause fear (DC 12), command (DC 12), longshot, true strike
0 (at will)—acid splash, bleed (DC 11), detect magic, guidance, resistance, sift

Domain Law

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 13, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 13, Cha 15
Base Atk +11; CMB +15; CMD 26
Feats Distracting Charge, Ferocious Loyalty, Great Fortitude, Gunsmithing, Improved Critical (bastard sword), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lunge, Outflank, Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (bastard sword), Weapon Specialization (pepperbox rifle)
Skills Diplomacy +7, Heal +10, Intimidate +21, Knowledge (local) +14, Perception +17, Sense Motive +20, Survival +7
Languages Common
SQ armor training 2, monster lore +1, solo tactics, stern gaze +3, track +3
Gear breastplate, mwk bastard sword, mwk pepperbox rifle, 20 bullets and black powder
